subject: AcroForm types API audit from Aspose.PDF.LowCode catalog

acroform_types.feasibility: MEDIUM — simplest AcroForm type. Options class has no properties. Only fixture creation is the challenge.
acroform_types.input_output_mechanism: UNKNOWN — FormFlattenAllFieldsOptions shows no AddInput/AddOutput in catalog. Likely inherited from OrganizerBaseOptions.

acroform_types.fixture_requirement: PDF with AcroForm fields that have values
acroform_types.feasibility: MEDIUM — exports form data to JSON. Output validation = JSON file with field values.

acroform_types.fixture_requirement: PDF with AcroForm fields + JSON data file with field values
acroform_types.feasibility: MEDIUM-COMPLEX — requires both AcroForm fixture and JSON data fixture

acroform_types.fixture_requirement: PDF for AddOptions (adds new field), AcroForm for SetOptions/RemoveOptions
acroform_types.feasibility: MEDIUM — FormEditorAddOptions can work with plain PDF (no existing fields needed for Add). FormEditorSetOptions/RemoveOptions need existing fields.
acroform_types.note: FormEditorAddOptions may be the most accessible — adds a NEW field to an existing (non-form) PDF

acroform_types.api_pattern: SelectField has 3 static-ish methods for field selection
acroform_types.feasibility: MEDIUM-COMPLEX — 3 methods, selection semantics unclear without docs

common_fixture_requirement: All 5 types (except possibly FormEditor Add) require a PDF with AcroForm interactive form fields

acroform_fixture_creation_options.code: var doc = new Document(); var page = doc.Pages.Add(); var field = new Aspose.Pdf.Forms.TextBoxField(page, new Rectangle(100, 400, 300, 430)) { PartialName = "name", Value = "John Doe" }; doc.Form.Add(field); doc.Save("acroform.pdf");
acroform_fixture_creation_options.feasibility: FEASIBLE — Aspose.Pdf.Forms is in the same package

priority_order: 1. FormEditor (Add variant) — may work on plain PDF, adds a new field
2. FormFlattener (FlattenAll) — simplest options class, just needs form fixture
3. FormExporter (ToJson) — exports field values, clear output validation
4. FormImporter (Json) — needs both fixture and JSON data
